anti_rescue: After the first Prince/Muse session receives a prepared packet, do not change the candidate generator, task generator, policy seal, baseline order seed, 16-task schedule, four-selection budget, packet protocol, researcher identity, visible-input invariant, pass threshold, available-tool policy, cost ceiling, or receiver acceptance rule. Freeze pass, no advantage, disadvantage, budget exhaustion, protocol failure, or execution failure. Any redesign gets a new experiment ID.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes only observed single-run live selection transfer on these fresh receiver-executed microtasks.
Prince may select any four candidates from the same full 12-candidate pool; the receiver independently executes the returned four in order and decides acceptance.
If Prince ignores or reconstructs the presentation order and the inherited advantage disappears, that negative result stands.

A pass does not establish Level 4 recursive improvement, recursive self-improvement, live coding productivity, repeatability, universal task-family transfer, production value, economic payback, or hostile-process isolation.
The ordering policy was inherited from prior calibration; it was not generated, independently promoted, and inherited by this live improvement loop, so recursive improvement remains unearned.

Candidate IDs, descriptions, features, history, public task information, researcher product/model, available-tool policy, and limits are matched. The only visible packet input allowed to differ is candidate presentation order.
Each arm uses one fresh Muse session. This is protocol separation, not a claim that Muse has no persistent product-level memory.

design.only_treatment: candidate presentation order from exact frozen evidence ranker versus frozen baseline order
design.researcher_authority: proposal-only selection of four candidate IDs and their evaluation order

economics.budget_exhaustion_rule: If either required Prince session cannot complete inside its $1.28 incremental-paid-spend authorization, stop the entire experiment and freeze BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_BEFORE_MATCH_COMPLETE. Do not retry, add funding, swap researcher/provider, or increase the ceiling.
economics.rule: Record actual incremental paid researcher cost for both sessions plus receiver and other incremental paid cost with basis/source; preserve researcher session counts, task decisions, receiver evaluations, and inherited 768-evaluation learning cost separately. Do not invent economic payback.

primary_metric.name: paired_receiver_confirmed_success_after_prince_selects_four_from_full_pool
positive_requires: evidence arm has at least two more receiver-confirmed successes than baseline across 16 paired tasks
evidence arm uses fewer downstream receiver evaluations than baseline
complete incremental paid cost record is within frozen $2.56 ceiling

question: Does the exact frozen evidence-derived presentation order improve Prince's ability to select receiver-confirmed executable improvements versus the frozen baseline presentation order when every other visible packet input, researcher configuration, available-tool policy, and limit is matched?
